items.name: theme
items.title: Agentcard theme
items.description: The Agentcard tokens and the Tailwind names that read them.

site.--ds-font-display: "Neue Haas Grotesk Display Pro", "Neue Haas Grotesk Display", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
site.--ds-font-mono: "Neue Haas Grotesk Display Pro", "Neue Haas Grotesk Display", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

items.name: about-page
items.useFor: Use as a starting point for Agentcard company pages. Replace sample people, links and content.
constraints: Photos in color beside gray ones
More than one blue-bar directory per page
items.title: About page
items.description: About page template with a header, team directory, footer and navigation.

items.name: accordion
items.useFor: Use for FAQs or details that can stay collapsed. The InWindow example adds topic tabs and a containing window.
constraints: More than one list open by default
items.source: agentcard-website src/app/globals.css (.faq-list, .v7-page summary, .v7-page details > p); live https://www.agentcard.sh/ (#faq .faq-list, computed)
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Expandable questions or sections with keyboard navigation.

items.name: avatar
items.useFor: Use beside a person’s name or role. Provide alt text on AvatarImage. Use size="lg" for larger profiles.
constraints: A ring or border around the photo
items.source: agentcard-website src/components/v7/company-page.tsx (PersonCard), src/app/globals.css (.v7-about-cell img, .is-founders .v7-about-cell img); live https://www.agentcard.sh/about
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Square grayscale photo with an initials fallback.

items.name: badge
items.useFor: Use tag, tag-ink and tag-heart for added, improved and fixed updates. Use status variants for state and chip for counts or filters.
constraints: Caps on anything but the tag
More than one tone per row
items.source: agentcard-website src/app/globals.css (.v7-upd-tag, .is-added, .is-improved, .is-fixed; .v7-guide-prose code for the chip); live https://www.agentcard.sh/updates
items.title: Badge
items.description: Labels for status, categories and counts.

items.name: band-divider
items.useFor: Use where blue sections meet white or paper. Hero, SiteFooter and Cta already include their dividers.
constraints: A divider between two sections on the same ground
Grain anywhere else on the page
items.title: Band divider
items.description: Stepped divider between page backgrounds.

items.name: banner
items.useFor: Use info for general notices, brand for announcements and alert for problems. Set name for the title bar and provide an action when one is needed.
constraints: More than one banner at a time
Banners for marketing copy that belongs in a section
items.source: Repository reference; public guide pages currently unavailable. agentcard-website src/app/globals.css (.v7-guide-note, .v7-guide-note-body, .v7-guide-cta-title, --guide-shadow); src/components/v7/guide-body.tsx (note)
items.title: Banner
items.description: Notice with a title, message and optional actions.

items.name: button
items.useFor: Use one primary action per section. Use secondary for other actions, on-brand on blue backgrounds and ghost in toolbars. Wire an onClick handler, use type="submit" for forms, or use asChild with a link for navigation.
constraints: Two blue keys side by side for equal actions
A gradient or glow on a key
items.source: agentcard-website src/app/globals.css:4159 (V7 buttons and tabs, one bevel)
items.title: Button
items.description: Buttons for primary, secondary, toolbar and on-blue actions.

items.name: card
items.useFor: Use default for features, plans or quotes. Use raised for product content with a preview. Use Window when the container needs a title bar.
items.title: Card
items.description: Container for related content, with default and raised variants.

items.name: checkbox
items.useFor: Use for multiple selections or a single agreement. Pair it with Label. When passing checked, update it through onCheckedChange.
constraints: Colors other than blue for checked
A checkbox for an action that happens at once (use a switch)
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Checkbox with checked, unchecked, indeterminate and disabled states.

items.name: code-window
items.useFor: Use for commands, integration examples and API requests. Pass code as a string for highlighting and copying, or pass rendered children.
constraints: A full syntax theme with many colors
Code set in a monospace other than the display face
items.title: Code window
items.description: Code block with a filename, highlighting and optional copy action.

items.name: collapse
items.useFor: Use for optional form fields, settings or details. Connect open to state and give the trigger aria-expanded and aria-controls.
items.title: Collapse
items.description: Expandable content area that animates its height.

items.name: command
items.useFor: Use Command for an inline list and CommandDialog for a palette. Connect each CommandItem onSelect to navigation or an action. Bind the dialog to Cmd/Ctrl K when needed.
constraints: A drop shadow on the panel
Icons in every row instead of a title and a line
items.source: Repository reference; public guide pages currently unavailable. agentcard-website src/components/v7/guide-search.tsx; src/app/globals.css (.v7-guide-search-layer, .v7-guide-search-panel, .v7-guide-search-field, .v7-guide-search-results, .v7-guide-search-group, .v7-guide-search-keys)
items.title: Command
items.description: Searchable command list or dialog with keyboard navigation.

items.name: copy-button
items.useFor: Place beside a command, key or ID and pass its value. Use a label that identifies what will be copied.
constraints: A copy button without a label for screen readers
items.title: Copy button
items.description: Copies text with success and failure feedback.

items.name: cta
items.useFor: Use near the end of a page when another action is needed. Provide a working link or handler for the action.
constraints: A blue key on the blue
A gradient or glow behind the headline
items.source: Extension from agentcard-website src/app/globals.css:1288 (.cta, an earlier closing stage); built from the hero's ground and the band divider (agentcard.sh has no closing CTA)
items.title: CTA
items.description: Blue section with a heading, action and optional media.

items.name: dialog
items.useFor: Use for a short form or confirmation. Provide a title and description. Set name for the title bar and size for wider content. Connect form submission and validation to the application.
constraints: A dialog opened from another dialog
Sliding in from an edge (use a sheet)
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Modal dialog with a title bar, focus trap and close control.

items.name: docs-link
items.useFor: Use to link to a guide or reference in a new tab. Provide the destination URL and a descriptive label.
constraints: Arrows on links that stay on the site
items.source: Extension from agentcard-website src/app/globals.css (links); live https://www.agentcard.sh/
items.title: Docs link
items.description: External documentation link with an arrow.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.useFor: Use for actions on an item or a compact navigation menu. Set variant="glass" on blue backgrounds. Use onSelect for actions and DropdownMenuHoldItem for destructive actions that require a hold.
constraints: Menus for navigation that should be visible
More than one level of submenu
A destructive row that fires on one click
items.source: https://agentcard.com/ (.v7-dock-card); white menu and extra item types are extensions
items.title: Dropdown menu
items.description: Action menu with standard and glass panels, submenus and selection controls.

items.name: empty-state
items.useFor: Explain what is missing and provide the next action. Set name for the title bar or null to hide it. Connect actions such as creating an item or clearing a search.
constraints: Empty states that blame the reader
items.title: Empty state
items.description: Message and optional action for an empty list or search result.

items.name: faq
items.useFor: Pass title, lead and topics containing questions and answers. A single topic hides the tabs. Set bar to label the window.
constraints: Answers longer than a short paragraph
A chevron in place of the drawn +
items.title: FAQ
items.description: FAQ section with optional topic tabs and expandable answers.

items.name: feature-rows
items.useFor: Use FeatureRows for the main feature list and FeatureGrid for supporting details. Supply a screen or illustration for each feature.
constraints: More than one blue key per row
items.title: Feature rows
items.description: Product feature layouts with text and media.

items.name: field
items.useFor: Wrap Input, Textarea, TagsInput or SelectTrigger. Derive error from the current value and clear it when valid. Use required for required fields and htmlFor when the control has an explicit id.
constraints: Labels inside the field as placeholders
items.title: Field
items.description: Label, help text, error message and accessibility attributes for a form control.

items.name: hero
items.useFor: Use at the top of an Agentcard home or product page. Put SiteHeader in header and background imagery in background. Use titleClassName to adjust title sizing or wrapping.
constraints: A blue key on the blue
A smooth fade into the page instead of the bands
items.title: Hero
items.description: Page opening with a blue background, heading, actions and optional media.

items.name: hold-button
items.useFor: Use for destructive actions such as closing a card. Connect onConfirm to the action. Releasing early, leaving the control or losing focus cancels the hold.
constraints: Hold for actions that can be undone
A blue fill for a destructive action
items.source: Extension from agentcard-website src/app/globals.css (--bevel-white); principles (keys sink on press)
items.title: Hold button
items.description: Button that confirms an action after a continuous hold.

items.name: home-page
items.useFor: Use as a starting point for an Agentcard landing page. Replace sample content and media, and check every link.
constraints: Blue grounds stacked between the hero and the footer
A window bar on every card
items.title: Home page
items.description: Home page template with product sections, integrations, FAQ and navigation.

items.name: input
items.useFor: Use inside Field for a label and validation message. Set an appropriate input type. Use variant="search" for search or filtering and connect changes to the results.
constraints: Rounded form fields (only the search box has corners)
Placeholder text as the only label
A glow or ring on focus (the brand draws the outline)
items.title: Input
items.description: Single-line text field with standard and search variants.

items.name: integrations
items.useFor: Pass rows with a title, description and options. Each option supplies a label, icon and panel. Use IntegrationCode and IntegrationScreen to build the preview.
constraints: More than six tools in one row
items.title: Integrations
items.description: Integration sections with selectable tools and matching previews.

items.name: kbd
items.useFor: Use in control hints, menu items and command palette instructions. The bare variant is for compact search hints.
constraints: Keys for things that are not keys
Keys in body copy larger than the text around them
items.source: Repository reference; public guide pages currently unavailable. agentcard-website src/app/globals.css (.v7-guide-search-keys kbd, .v7-guide-search kbd)
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Keyboard key or shortcut label.

items.name: label
items.useFor: Use the default form label above an input. Use variant=control for the larger label beside a checkbox, switch or radio. Connect htmlFor to the control id, or use Field to connect it automatically.
constraints: Labels without a control to point at
items.source: https://agentcard.com/get-started (.v7-gate-field > span); control variant is an extension
items.title: Label
items.description: Accessible label for a form control.

items.name: logo-strip
items.useFor: Pass customer names and logos. Use the optional tone for the title bar. The layout adapts to the number of customers and screen width.
constraints: Bars in colors other than the five tints and sky
Links or buttons inside the windows
items.title: Logo strip
items.description: Customer logos in a responsive grid of small windows.

items.name: logo
items.useFor: Use Lockup in headers and footers, and LogoMark in smaller spaces. Set label={null} when the containing link already has an accessible name.
constraints: The logo in a color other than blue
A drop shadow or glow behind the logo
The wordmark retyped in a font
items.title: Logo
items.description: Agentcard wordmark and standalone mark.

items.name: marquee
items.useFor: Use for a merchant, customer or partner list. Use at most one per page.
constraints: Logos in color on the line
Two running lines on one page
Text a reader must read to act
items.title: Marquee
items.description: Scrolling row of names that pauses on hover and respects reduced motion.

items.name: nav-dock
items.useFor: Use with SiteHeader. Mark the current page and provide working destinations. Set hideAt to the footer’s id to hide the dock while the footer is visible.
constraints: Animating the dock on every scroll
items.title: Nav dock
items.description: Floating navigation that becomes a top bar and menu on phones.

items.name: page-header
items.useFor: Place below SiteHeader on company, form, legal or update pages. Put supporting title content in children.
items.title: Page header
items.description: Title, optional label and introduction for an inner page.

items.name: popover
items.useFor: Use for explanations, filters or small controls. Use variant="glass" over blue backgrounds or imagery. Keep longer tasks in Dialog or Sheet.
constraints: Forms longer than a few fields (use a dialog)
Popovers that open on hover (use a tooltip)
items.title: Popover
items.description: Anchored panel for contextual details or controls.

items.name: pricing-page
items.useFor: Use as a starting point for Agentcard pricing pages. Set the current plans, features and action URLs.
constraints: More than one featured plan per product
items.title: Pricing page
items.description: Pricing page template with product tabs, plans, footer and navigation.

items.name: pricing
items.useFor: Pass title and products with their plans, prices, features and actions. Use one featured plan per product. A single product hides the tabs.
constraints: More than one featured plan per product
Repeating the free plan's features in the paid plan (use includes)
A pill or secondary key for the plan's action
items.title: Pricing
items.description: Pricing plans grouped by product, with optional tabs.

items.name: product-grid
items.useFor: Pass products with title, description, action and media. Use layout="lead" for a full-width card and layout="half" for paired cards.
constraints: An odd number of half cards
Media on a white ground instead of the stage
items.title: Product grid
items.description: Product overview cards with text, actions and media.

items.name: progress
items.useFor: Use for spending limits, uploads or setup progress. Update value as progress changes and set max when the scale is not 100. Give the bar an accessible label.
constraints: Progress without a label saying what it measures
items.title: Progress
items.description: Progress bar with a value, maximum and accessible progress state.

items.name: prose
items.useFor: Use for documentation, guides, legal content and release notes. Pass semantic HTML or rendered Markdown. Use wide for a wider content column.
items.title: Prose
items.description: Typography and layout for long-form content.

items.name: scroll-area
items.useFor: Use for a list or log inside a fixed-height window or panel.
constraints: Hiding the main content in one
Scrolling the whole page in one
items.title: Scroll area
items.description: Scrollable container with overflow indicators and a scroll control.

items.name: secret-field
items.useFor: Use for API keys or card details. Provide a descriptive label. Use defaultRevealed only when the value should initially be visible.
constraints: Showing a secret in full by default
items.title: Secret field
items.description: Masked value with reveal and copy controls.

items.name: section
items.useFor: Use SiteSection for content layout, SectionHeading for the title and description, and Eyebrow for an optional label. Choose white, paper or blue backgrounds as needed.
constraints: Two blue sections in a row
Left-aligned section titles over centered content
A ground change without a band divider
items.title: Section
items.description: Page section, section heading and optional label.

items.name: segmented-control
items.useFor: Use for a small set of options such as billing period or card type. Connect value and onValueChange. Use size="sm" in compact layouts and variant="plain" in toolbars.
constraints: Switching between pages or panels (use tabs)
items.source: live https://www.agentcard.sh/pricing (.plan-tabs, .plan-tabs-thumb); src/app/globals.css (.v7-guide-tablist for size sm)
items.title: Segmented control
items.description: Single-value selector with radio semantics and arrow-key navigation.

items.name: select
items.useFor: Use the field appearance inside Field for forms. Use compact in dense rows and ghost or chip for filters. Field required is inherited by Select. Give Select a name for FormData; keep value and onValueChange on the root. Use compact on SelectContent for compact fields and toolbar menus.
constraints: Long lists without a search (use a command)
items.source: https://agentcard.com/get-started (native field); Radix menu extends repository guide styles
items.title: Select
items.description: Single-choice select with field, compact, ghost and chip treatments.

items.name: separator
items.useFor: Use between related content groups or inline controls.
constraints: Rules between every row of a card
A smooth fade between the blue and white grounds (that is the band divider)
items.title: Separator
items.description: Horizontal or vertical divider.

items.name: sheet
items.useFor: Use for item details, activity logs or longer forms. Choose right, left or bottom with side. Set modal={false} when the rest of the page must remain interactive.
constraints: Sheets for a quick confirmation (use a dialog)
items.source: Extension from agentcard-website src/app/globals.css (.v7-guide-nav, .v7-windowbar); live https://www.agentcard.sh (.v7-gate::backdrop)
items.title: Sheet
items.description: Side panel with a title, close control and focus management.

items.name: site-footer
items.useFor: Provide link groups, description and optional backing content. Check that every link resolves. Add an id when NavDock uses hideAt.
items.title: Site footer
items.description: Footer with navigation groups, logos and optional merchant list.

items.name: site-header
items.useFor: Use at the top of a page. Pair with NavDock for navigation. Hide the header on phones when the dock already provides the mobile header.
constraints: A filled or sticky header bar
A blue key in the header
items.title: Site header
items.description: Page header with the Agentcard logo and a primary link.

items.name: skeleton
items.useFor: Match the expected content dimensions and replace it when loading completes.
constraints: Skeletons for content that loads at once
Gray blocks that do not match the final layout
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Placeholder that reserves space while content loads.

items.name: sonner
items.useFor: Mount one Toaster near the application root. Show a toast after an action succeeds or fails. Connect any toast action to its intended behavior.
constraints: Toasts for errors that need an answer (use a dialog or a banner)
items.source: Repository reference; public guide pages currently unavailable. agentcard-website src/app/globals.css (.v7-toast, .v7-toast-icon), src/components/v7/guide-client.tsx (GuideToaster)
items.title: Toast
items.description: Toast notifications with optional actions.

items.name: spinner
items.useFor: Use during a pending operation. Pair it with a label, prevent duplicate submissions when needed and restore the control when the operation finishes.
constraints: Colored spinners that ignore their text
items.source: Extension using the site text colors and reduced-motion behavior; no standalone spinner found on the current public site
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Loading indicator that inherits the surrounding text color.

items.name: sticker-field
items.useFor: Use with Agentcard illustrations in section margins. Keep content and controls unobstructed. Motion stops for reduced-motion preferences.
constraints: Stickers on phones over the column
More than eight in one section
items.source: agentcard-website src/components/v7/sticker-rails.tsx, src/components/faq-stickers.tsx; src/app/globals.css:899 (.faq-sticker), 1605 (.v7-sticker-rails); agentcard.sh / and /pricing (computed)
items.title: Sticker field
items.description: Decorative floating objects positioned around section content.

items.name: striped-wordmark
items.useFor: Use across the bottom of SiteFooter on blue. Supports short uppercase words.
constraints: Set in a font instead of the bars
items.title: Striped wordmark
items.description: SVG wordmark with horizontal stripes.

items.name: surface
items.useFor: Wrap an area with the required white, paper or blue ground so content and overlays use matching colors.
constraints: Blue grounds stacked one after another
A blue ground behind long text
items.title: Surface
items.description: Background and text context shared by a section and its overlays.

items.name: switch
items.useFor: Pair with Label. Connect checked and onCheckedChange when the application owns the setting.
constraints: Colors other than blue for on
A switch inside a form that needs a submit (use a checkbox)
items.source: Extension from agentcard-website src/app/globals.css (THE PLAN TABS, --bevel-white)
items.title: Switch
items.description: Toggle for a setting that takes effect immediately.

items.name: table
items.useFor: Use for purchases, cards, plans or other comparable records. Give each TableCell after the first a label for the mobile layout. Use Badge for statuses.
constraints: Tables nested in a card or window (the table is its own frame)
items.source: Repository reference; public guide pages currently unavailable. agentcard-website src/app/globals.css (.v7-guide-table)
items.title: Table
items.description: Responsive table that stacks row content on phones.

items.name: tabs
items.useFor: Use for related views such as plans, FAQ topics or item details. Give each TabsTrigger a matching TabsContent. Use glide={false} when supplying a custom selected state.
constraints: More than one blue key in a track
items.source: live https://www.agentcard.sh/pricing (.plan-tabs, .plan-tab, .plan-tabs-thumb); src/app/globals.css (.v7-guide-tablist for size sm)
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tabbed views with default, small and plain treatments.

items.name: tag-filter
items.useFor: Connect onAddTag and onRemoveTag to the filter state, then apply those filters to the results.
constraints: Filters that hide which tags are on
items.title: Tag filter
items.description: Searchable tag picker with removable selected filters.

items.name: tags-input
items.useFor: Use inside Field for domains, emails or similar values. Enter or comma adds a value; Backspace removes the last value when the input is empty. Provide isTagInvalid for validation.
constraints: Tags without a way to remove them
Free text that should be a textarea
items.source: Extension from live https://www.agentcard.sh/get-started (.v7-gate-field input); src/app/globals.css (.v7-guide-prose code)
items.title: Tags input
items.description: Editable list of values with add, remove and validation states.

items.name: team-directory
items.useFor: Use for teams, advisors, investors or partners. Use tone="blue" for the primary directory and the default tone for others. Provide current names and links.
constraints: More than one blue-bar window per page
Cards with gaps between people instead of the ruled grid
items.title: Team directory
items.description: Responsive directory of people with photos, roles and optional links.

items.name: testimonials
items.useFor: Pass cases with name, logo, quote, context and tag. Use approved customer quotes and attribution.
constraints: More than one quote per window
A trail of a single case
Photos in place of the company's mark
items.title: Testimonials
items.description: Customer quotes with names, logos and optional context.

items.name: textarea
items.useFor: Use inside Field for messages, notes and other longer input. Connect value and onChange when the form owns the state.
items.source: Published CSS on https://agentcard.com/get-started (.v7-gate-field textarea); the current visible form has no textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Resizable multi-line text field.

items.name: tooltip
items.useFor: Use to explain an icon control or add brief context. Keep a separate accessible name on the control; do not put essential instructions only in the tooltip.
constraints: Tooltips for anything needed to finish a task
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Short contextual label shown on hover or keyboard focus.

items.name: updates-feed
items.useFor: Use for changelogs or activity updates. Provide dates, change groups and optional media. Place in a Prose column or another readable content width.
constraints: Colors other than blue ink and red for tags
items.source: agentcard.sh/updates (computed: .v7-upd-feed, .v7-upd-day, .v7-upd-tag, .v7-upd-group, .v7-upd-video); not in the agentcard-website source yet
items.title: Updates feed
items.description: Dated release notes grouped by change type.

items.name: use-hold
items.useFor: Use for hold-to-confirm controls. Spread handlers on the control and use isHolding for its visual state. Pass disabled to prevent confirmation.
constraints: Hold for actions that can be undone
items.title: useHold
items.description: Confirms after a continuous pointer or keyboard hold and cancels when interrupted.

items.name: use-tab-glide
items.useFor: Use for a shared selection indicator in a row of options. The indicator is measured from the parent’s outer edge; account for the border when positioning it.
constraints: Animating the key with a timed transition that restarts when interrupted
items.title: useTabGlide
items.description: Moves a selection indicator between tabs, respecting reduced motion.

items.name: use-trail
items.useFor: Use with Testimonials or LogoStrip layouts. Mark cards with data-trail-card and apply the matching TRAIL_REST position.
constraints: A trail through a single card
items.title: useTrail
items.description: Draws a responsive connecting line through a set of cards.

items.name: utils
items.useFor: Use cn to combine component classes and caller overrides.
items.title: cn
items.description: Class-name utilities that understand the design token scales.

items.name: window
items.useFor: Use for plans, directories, code examples and other grouped content that needs a title. Use at most one blue title bar per group.
constraints: A window bar on every card of a page
Colored bars other than sky blue and the five tints
items.title: Window
items.description: Content container with a title bar and optional controls.
